title: Our support promise
lead: When you answer and how fast. Agents promise nothing beyond what is written here.

fields.label: When are you available to customers?
fields.hint: Such as: Monday to Saturday, ten in the morning to six.

fields.label: How fast do you reply?
fields.hint: Such as: Within one working day.

fields.label: What do you never promise?
fields.hint: Such as: A fixed finish date before the site is seen.
